name: Dual Phase ~ Netorareru Hanayome to Kegasareta Wedding Dress
original_name: デュアルフェーズ～寝取られる花嫁と汚されたウエディングドレス
source:
Kenta hears a rumor that his childhood friend Eijiro is going to get married. His future bride's name is Miu, who is a very pretty girl with very big breasts.
However, Miu has a secret and Kenta comes up with an idea of humiliating her during the wedding party.

How about teasing a bride during the wedding ceremony?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056869.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
古浦健太听说青梅竹马菜田荣一郎即将结婚。新娘等宗美羽容貌出众，胸部也十分丰满。然而，美羽藏着一个秘密，健太因此萌生出在婚宴上羞辱她的念头。

在婚礼上捉弄新娘，岂不是很有趣？
